name: distributed-job-scheduler
description: A multi-tenant distributed job scheduling platform featuring atomic claiming, resilient state transitions, DLQ, and a live WebSocket dashboard.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,dashboard -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w packages/api" "npm run dev -w packages/worker" "npm run dev -w packages/dashboard"
scripts.build: npm install --include=dev && npm run build -w packages/api && npm run build -w packages/worker && npm run build -w packages/dashboard
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/api && npm run test -w packages/worker
